coverage.summary: Coverage unknown. Only the bill history page of this Boston rent stabilization home-rule petition is available, not the bill text. The bill accompanied a study order and was not enacted.

evidence.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections

result.notes: D011 is only the legislative history page for H.3744. It contains no bill text, so it states no unit thresholds, construction cutoffs, owner-occupancy or new-construction exemptions, or preemption terms. All substantive coverage fields stay null. The summary was reworded so that it rests only on what D011 shows: the bill title and the study-order disposition. D010, D012, D013 and D014 cover other Boston measures (Fair Chance policy, fair housing, HSNA) and contain nothing on H.3744's coverage.
